_comment: C/M4 two-sided routing corpus. The measurement in PHASE_6_GOAL_6-6_ROUTING.md §9 (commit 5e9d746) was DOCS-ONLY: §9 reports the totals (37 genuine status / 32 conceptual = 69) and the construction rule, but enumerates only ~14 of the 69 questions verbatim. Everything marked source='recovered' is quoted from §9; everything marked source='rebuilt' was constructed under the SAME rule and is NEW. A rebuilt corpus is therefore NOT byte-comparable to §9's recorded 32/69 baseline — the baseline is re-measured here on THIS corpus and both numbers are reported. This file exists so the next session looks the corpus up instead of re-deriving it from prose (the artifact-survives-the-session lesson, which has already bitten this project twice).
_construction_rule: conceptual = a technical/CS question that merely CONTAINS a SYSFACTS family word and must route ROUTE_INFER; genuine = a real operator status question that must route ROUTE_SYSFACTS. Coverage targets all FIVE reachable SYSFACTS paths (MODEL/NODES/HEALTH/UPTIME/BOOT_ID) and the nine both-sides words (boot, cycles, errors, faults, gguf, model, ok, problems, wrong). The genuine side deliberately over-weights NO-SELF-REFERENCE phrasings, because that is the quadrant the keyword anchor died in (§9.3: it turned on whether the operator said 'you').
_expect: conceptual -> ROUTE_INFER (a SYSFACTS/DECLINE capture is a FALSE POSITIVE). genuine -> ROUTE_SYSFACTS (an INFER fallthrough is a FALSE NEGATIVE).
